calendar.text: Nvidia reports quarterly results after the US market closes
Minutes of the Fed’s October meeting
Trump, Xi and Putin are due to meet in Shenzhen
Spain: TV debate between Sánchez and Feijóo
COP31 is due to end in Antalya
EU summit: leaders aim to choose the next ECB president
The new US Congress takes office

held.t: Iran: a report that Iran’s foreign minister held talks in Muscat, Oman, on Tuesday. One source so far.
Iran: a Euronews report that the US struck missile launchers in southern Iran on Sunday night. No second source and no US confirmation in the reports seen.

Ukraine: a Russian official’s statement, carried by state media, that 1,200 to 1,300 prisoners from each side could be exchanged. No independent confirmation, and no sign yet that the exchange has started.
Ukraine: a report that European leaders agreed a joint negotiating team on 13 November. One source so far.
Ukraine: reports that overnight Russian attacks damaged Kyiv’s metro and two bridges, and that about 800 drones flew towards Moscow. One source so far.
ECB: reports that policymakers expect to raise rates in December and then pause. One source so far.
China: reports that October industrial output and retail sales missed forecasts. One source so far.
Banks: a report that the EU cleared UniCredit’s takeover of Germany’s Commerzbank. One source so far.

note: Full check of the news, under the new rule to publish every confirmed story. New stories: Nvidia and the tech sell-off, the US rule on AI chips, five EU countries’ Rwanda deportation plan, and new Canada–China tariff cuts. Updates: the Trump–Xi–Putin meeting and Iran.
